design: paired task comparisons wherever feasible; treatment/executor/shaping definitions frozen before observation
mean_policy: report mean only alongside distribution because cost and latency may be skewed
repetition_rule: after S2, increase equally across treatments until uncertainty for the intended limited claim is sufficiently stable or a predeclared resource ceiling is reached; never stop because a preferred treatment leads
small_sample_rule: descriptive evidence and INCONCLUSIVE; no universal superiority claim
p_value_rule: no arbitrary p-value threshold is asserted without a later justified estimand/design amendment
